Typography

round(17 x 1.2^n): 14, 17, 20, 24, 29, 35, 42px. Weights body 400, label 400, heading 600.

headline.lg 42/52 600Page and section titles.
headline.md 35/44 600Page and section titles.
headline.sm 29/36 600Page and section titles.
title.lg 24/32 600Card, panel and group titles.
numeric.lg 24/32 600Key numbers: balances, KPIs.
body.lg 20/28 400Long-form reading, onboarding copy.
title.md 20/28 600Card, panel and group titles.
body.md 17/24 400Default UI text: forms, tables, descriptions.
label.lg 17/24 400Button and control labels.
code.md 17/24 400Code blocks, token names.
title.sm 17/24 600Table headers, field-group titles.
numeric.md 17/24 400Amounts and table figures: tabular digits line up in columns; right-align numeric columns.
body.sm 14/20 400Helper text, timestamps, captions.
label.sm 14/20 400Overlines in capitals with wide tracking (DC-L02-18).
label.md 14/20 400Small control labels, badges, dense tabs.
code.sm 14/20 400Inline values, dense code rows.
